scope: Historical integration measurements; not measurements of the freshly extracted publication branch. Q4 and Q8 partial-residency token differences remain unclassified.
hardware: RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation 96 GB, 400 W; Ryzen 9 7950X; 128 GB host RAM
method: Greedy, FP16 KV, shared weights, private states, fixed-length output. All input tokens actually read. Cohort prefill front-loaded; streaming metrics taken only while all requests decode.
